Join us for the live broadcast of a Ukrainian Premier League match, where FC Oleksandriya will host the top-flight newcomer, Epitsentr Dunayivtsi. This is a battle between two teams from the lower part of the league table, for whom every point is worth its weight in gold.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 24, 2025, 12:30 UTC (15:30 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

FC Oleksandriya comes into this match in a deep crisis. The team is showing very poor results in the Premier League, where they are fighting for survival. Oleksandriya has been particularly dismal away from home, losing all their guest matches this season. A home match against a direct competitor is one of the best opportunities for the team to end their run of poor results and gain vital points.

Epitsentr, a UPL debutant, had a very confident start in the top flight, but the team's form has dipped in recent matches. Despite this, the club from the Khmelnytskyi region has already proven to be a tough nut to crack, capable of taking points even from more experienced opponents. Epitsentr will be looking to end their unsuccessful streak and improve their position in the fight to stay in the Premier League.

Head-to-Head History

The teams have not previously met in official matches. This will be their first head-to-head encounter in the Premier League, which adds an element of unpredictability to the match.

FC Oleksandriya vs Epitsentr Dunayivtsi Prediction

Experts expect a very tense battle of underdogs, making it difficult to pick a favorite. The current form of both teams raises big questions. Oleksandriya will have the home-field advantage, but Epitsentr has already shown that they know how to play for a result.

Join us for the live broadcast of this Uzbekistan Super League fixture, where Qizilqum Navoiy hosts Dinamo from the historic city of Samarqand. This is a crucial showdown for two teams aiming to solidify their positions in the league table.

Kick-off: October 24, 2025, 12:00 UTC (17:00 Tashkent Time)

Stadium: Yoshlik Stadium, Navoiy

Competition: Uzbekistan Super League

Qizilqum vs Dinamo Samarqand: Match Preview

Matches between Qizilqum and Dinamo Samarqand are always hard-fought battles. For the home side, this match is an excellent opportunity to strengthen their league standing and please their fans, as Qizilqum is traditionally a strong home team. Dinamo, meanwhile, will be desperate to secure vital away points to improve their position in the league table.

Team Form and Analysis

Qizilqum (Navoiy)

Qizilqum is a solid mid-table team capable of causing problems for any opponent, especially at home. The team relies on an organized defense and swift counter-attacks. Their attacking efforts are often led by the experienced Georgian legionnaire, Elguja Grigalashvili, who poses the main threat to the opposition's goal.

Dinamo (Samarqand)

The team from Samarqand is known for its fighting spirit. They often achieve results through sheer determination and tactical discipline. For Dinamo, the key task in this match will be to neutralize the hosts' attacking potential and effectively capitalize on set-piece opportunities.

Veres Rivne vs Zorya Luhansk: Watch Live Stream Online - UPL 24.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of a Ukrainian Premier League match, where Veres Rivne will host Zorya Luhansk. This is a clash between two teams from the lower half of the league table, making this an important battle to improve their positions.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 24, 2025, 15:00 UTC (18:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

Veres comes into this match in a profound crisis. The team is in the direct relegation zone, sitting in 15th place. The Rivne side has suffered six consecutive defeats in all competitions, demonstrating very poor play in both attack and defense. In their last five league matches, Veres has scored only one goal while conceding eleven. A home match is a chance for the team to break their terrible streak and gain vital points.

Zorya is also not having the best season and is in 12th place, just a few points above the relegation zone. The Luhansk team has shown inconsistent results, but they look more favorable compared to their opponent. In the last round, Zorya lost a hard-fought match to Dynamo Kyiv (1-2), but before that, they had secured two victories. The team will be aiming to take three points against the underdog.

Head-to-Head History

The history of confrontations between these teams favors Zorya. In seven head-to-head meetings, the Luhansk side has won four times, while Veres has been victorious only once, with two matches ending in a draw. The last meeting between the teams in May 2025 ended in a 2-0 victory for Zorya.

Veres Rivne vs Zorya Luhansk Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider Zorya the favorite, despite their away status. Their squad looks significantly stronger, and the crisis Veres is in leaves the hosts with little chance.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for Zorya. The Luhansk team should comfortably defeat a team in such poor form.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering Veres's struggles in attack (1 goal in 5 matches), it is unlikely they will be able to score. A bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' seems logical.
  • Key Factor: The deep crisis of Veres versus the higher class and motivation of Zorya.

Tune into the Veres Rivne vs Zorya Luhansk live stream on tutsport.net and follow the tense battle in the UPL!

Join us for the live broadcast of an 8th round match in the Italian Serie A, where one of the giants, AC Milan, will host the top-flight newcomer, Pisa, at their legendary San Siro stadium.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 24, 2025, 18:45 UTC (21:45 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

AC Milan comes into this match in low spirits. Stefano Pioli's side has suffered a series of defeats in Serie A and the Champions League, increasing the pressure on the coach and players. Despite this, the 'Rossoneri' remain among the league leaders and will be highly motivated to redeem themselves in front of their fans in a match against an underdog. The home game at the San Siro is an excellent opportunity to end their run of poor results.

Pisa, having returned to Serie A after a long absence, is expectedly fighting for survival. The team is in the lower part of the league table and struggles in matches against top clubs. However, in games against teams of similar level, Pisa has already proven that they can collect points. The trip to the San Siro will be a major test for the league newcomer, but also a chance to make a statement.

Head-to-Head History

There have been no recent official top-flight meetings between these teams, as they have competed in different divisions for a long time.

AC Milan vs Pisa Prediction

Experts and bookmakers unanimously consider AC Milan the undisputed favorite. The vast difference in class, the home-field advantage, and the desire to bounce back from recent setbacks leave the visitors with virtually no chance.

  • Likely Outcome: A convincing victory for AC Milan. The 'Rossoneri' are expected to dominate from the first minutes and should secure a win by a large margin.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering that Milan will be looking for a big win to boost morale and Pisa has defensive problems, a bet on 'Over 2.5 goals' looks very likely.

Real Sociedad vs Sevilla: Live Stream & Watch La Liga Online

Live broadcast of the headline match of La Liga's 9th round, featuring Real Sociedad hosting Sevilla. Watch the online stream in the player above.

Kick-off: October 24, 2025, 19:00 UTC

Stadium: Reale Arena (Anoeta), San Sebastián

Competition: La Liga, Matchday 9

Real Sociedad vs Sevilla Match Preview

Tonight's fixture is more than just another league game; it's a tactical battle between two contenders for a Champions League spot. Imanol Alguacil's Real Sociedad, known for their technical, possession-based style, will test the resilience and experience of a tough Sevilla side.

Team Analysis and Current Form

Real Sociedad

The Basques have had an excellent start to the season, showing confident performances in both La Liga and European competitions. The team is particularly formidable at their home ground, the Reale Arena, where they rarely drop points with the backing of their fans. Key players are in top form, making La Real's attack a significant threat.

Sevilla

After overcoming some early-season instability, the Andalusians have hit their stride and are currently on a long unbeaten run. The team is renowned for its fighting spirit and big-game mentality. Sevilla will likely rely on a solid defensive structure and quick counter-attacks.

Head-to-Head (H2H) Statistics

The history between these clubs highlights their status as evenly matched rivals. The last six encounters have resulted in just one win for Sevilla and five draws, underscoring how difficult an opponent the Andalusians are for the Basque club. Most of their matches are tight, low-scoring affairs.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official team sheets will be announced one hour before the match begins.

  • Real Sociedad (4-3-3): Álex Remiro - Hamari Traoré, Robin Le Normand, Jon Pacheco, Javi Galán - Martín Zubimendi, Mikel Merino, Brais Méndez - Takefusa Kubo, Mikel Oyarzabal, Ander Barrenetxea.
  • Sevilla (4-2-3-1): Ørjan Nyland - Jesús Navas, Loïc Badé, Sergio Ramos, Marcos Acuña - Djibril Sow, Boubakary Soumaré - Lucas Ocampos, Óliver Torres, Dodi Lukebakio - Youssef En-Nesyri.

Match Prediction and Betting Tips

Bookmakers and experts see no clear favorite, but give a slight edge to the home side due to their home-field advantage.

  • Main Prediction: Draw or Real Sociedad to Win (Double Chance 1X). The Basques are very strong at home, but breaking down Sevilla's defense will be a major challenge.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Under 2.5 Goals. Considering the H2H stats and the tactical caution of both teams, a high-scoring game is unlikely.
  • Key Factor: The midfield battle. Real Sociedad's possession game against the power and experience of Sevilla's midfield will likely decide the outcome.

Leeds United vs West Ham United: Live Stream & Watch Premier League Online

Join us for the live broadcast of an uncompromising Premier League clash as Leeds United host West Ham United at Elland Road. This is a classic battle of styles: the high-octane attack of the home side against the organized and resilient visitors.

Kick-off: October 24, 2025, 19:00 UTC (20:00 UK Time)

Stadium: Elland Road, Leeds

Competition: English Premier League

Leeds vs West Ham: Match Preview

Driven by their passionate home crowd, Leeds always employ an aggressive, high-energy style of football, aiming to dominate from the first whistle. For the Peacocks, home games are a key opportunity to secure points. West Ham, meanwhile, are one of the most tactically astute teams in the league, capable of weathering storms and punishing any defensive lapse.

Team Form and Analysis

Leeds United

The team relies on a high press and rapid wing play. Pacy wingers like Crysencio Summerville and the creative forward Georginio Rutter are central to their attack. The main challenge for Leeds is maintaining a balance between their offensive rushes and defensive stability, as their commitment to attack often leaves them vulnerable to counter-attacks.

West Ham United

The Hammers prefer a pragmatic approach, building their game on a solid defensive foundation. Their main strengths are set-pieces, where James Ward-Prowse's delivery is second to none, and swift counter-attacks featuring the explosive pace of Jarrod Bowen and Mohammed Kudus. West Ham are extremely dangerous in matches where their opponents control possession.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Leeds (4-2-3-1): Meslier - Gray, Rodon, Ampadu, Firpo - Kamara, Gruev - Summerville, Rutter, James - Piroe.
  • West Ham (4-2-3-1): Areola - Coufal, Zouma, Aguerd, Emerson - Álvarez, Souček - Bowen, Ward-Prowse, Kudus - Antonio.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Expect a vibrant, high-tempo match with plenty of action.

  • Main Prediction: Both Teams to Score (BTTS): Yes. Leeds' attacking philosophy and West Ham's potent counter-attack make an exchange of goals highly likely.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Matches at Elland Road are rarely dull, and this one should be no exception.
